name: 404 Redirect to Homepage or Custom URL
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
🚀 The Ultimate 404 Redirect Solution for WordPress – Automatically redirect visitors from broken pages to your homepage or any custom URL (including external sites) with just one click. Boost SEO rankings by replacing 404 errors with SEO-friendly 301 redirects.

Why Choose This Plugin?
✔ SEO Optimized: 301 redirects preserve your search rankings better than 404 errors
✔ User Experience: No more dead ends for your visitors
✔ Flexible Redirection: Works with any URL (internal pages or external websites)
✔ Lightweight: No performance impact on your site
✔ Zero Configuration: Set it and forget it

🔗 Professional WordPress plugin by DominoPress – Trusted by 1000+ websites
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “404 Redirect to Homepage or Custom URL”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. Configure under Settings → 404 Redirect
sections.faq:
How does this plugin help my SEO?

This plugin automatically converts 404 errors into 301 redirects, which tells search engines that pages have permanently moved. This preserves your search rankings much better than showing 404 errors.

Can I redirect 404 pages to external websites?

Yes! You can enter any valid URL including external websites (e.g., https://example.com). Perfect for affiliate marketers or site migrations.

Will this slow down my website?

Not at all. The plugin is lightweight and only activates when a 404 error occurs, with zero impact on normal page loads.

What’s the difference between this and other redirect plugins?

This plugin focuses specifically on 404 errors with a simple, no-nonsense interface. No complicated rules or settings – just pure 404 redirection.

Can I track how many 404 redirects are happening?

While this plugin doesn’t include analytics, you can use Google Analytics to track 404 pages by checking your “Page Not Found” reports.
